source_text.body:
Answer stock and price questions from a data store
A read-only Make AI Agent looks up stock and price for products in a Make Data store via a tool scenario; the author measured credit cost on the Free plan.
·
Nov 10, 2026
Done with
MK
Make
What they did
The author built a read-only inventory assistant in Make on the Free plan. A Make AI Agent using Make’s AI Provider and the Small recommended model answered questions like product stock and price by calling one on-demand tool scenario that searched a Make Data store with three fictional products; it could only read data, not reserve, order, or edit stock.
How it went
It worked for six demo questions at about 1.08 to 1.30 credits each, roughly 1.1 to 1.3 per question. The main failures were operational: the tool scenario had to be active, a stray placeholder module broke the trigger, and plural product names were not matched.
Worth knowing
This setup used both active scenarios available on the Free plan, which only includes 1,000 credits per month.
Try it yourself
with
Make
Copy prompt
Help me build a read-only Make AI Agent that answers questions like 'Is [product name] in stock and what does it cost?' using my Make Data store [data store name]. Set up a tool scenario that searches the store by product name and returns stock and price, and give the agent instructions to only read and never edit or delete records. It's done when I can ask about three sample products and get correct answers, and tell me roughly how many credits each question uses.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/Make/comments/1xsibfy/i_tested_a_make_ai_agent_on_the_free_plan
